finalText:
I tightened the spacing in the features section using token values:
- **Grid:** the gap between cards went from 16 to 12, and the bottom padding from 64 to 48.
- **Cards:** the inner padding on all three cards went from 24 to 16.

The render looks right. There's still some empty space under the cards. It may come from a second grid row that has nothing in it. I set that row gap to 12, up from an off-token 10, so the space may be a little larger than before.
